description: At night the Plaza Mayor of Trujillo is beautifully lit — the equestrian statue of Francisco Pizarro standing at its centre among the Renaissance palaces and noble mansions whose façades glow warm in the night lighting, the church of San Martín rising at one corner. Travellers note the square's evening lighting as one of its glories, and the town of conquistadors settles into its old stone. Beyond the plaza the walled old town climbs to the castle.
